scenarios.name: workshop-availability-phrased-question

history.content: When is Monica's hormone workshop next on?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent answers directly with the workshop's fixed details (free, one-off 60-minute group session on women's hormone health with Monica Francia, on the 7th of September at 5:30pm) and appends the closing line, without calling smart_voice_agent. FAIL if the agent proceeds into PRACTITIONER AVAILABILITY INTERCEPT STEP 1/2/3 and calls smart_voice_agent with intent="find_next_available" and Monica's Naturopathy appointment_type_id (1980142155343075904), since the workshop is not a recurring bookable slot and that appointment type has nothing to do with it.

scenarios.name: workshop-free-slot-phrasing

history.content: Is Monica free for the workshop?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent answers directly with the workshop's fixed details (free, one-off 60-minute group session on women's hormone health with Monica Francia, on the 7th of September at 5:30pm) and appends the closing line, without calling smart_voice_agent. FAIL if the agent calls smart_voice_agent with intent="find_next_available" and a Naturopathy appointment_type_id, or otherwise treats this as a general Monica availability lookup rather than a workshop question.

scenarios.name: monica-ordinary-availability-unaffected
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent proceeds through the normal PRACTITIONER AVAILABILITY INTERCEPT flow: says "Checking that now, one moment." and calls smart_voice_agent with intent="find_next_available", appointment_type="Naturopathy", appointment_type_id="1980142155343075904", practitioner="Monica Francia". FAIL if the agent instead answers with the Women's Hormone Health Workshop details -- this caller never mentioned the workshop, so the new workshop intercept must not fire and must not swallow an ordinary practitioner-availability question.

scenarios.name: workshop-event-phrasing-no-keyword
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent answers directly with the workshop's fixed details (free, one-off 60-minute group session on women's hormone health with Monica Francia, on the 7th of September at 5:30pm) and appends the closing line, without calling smart_voice_agent -- 'event' involving Monica should be recognized as workshop language even without the words 'workshop' or 'hormone'. FAIL if the agent calls smart_voice_agent with intent="find_next_available" for Monica's Naturopathy appointment type.

scenarios.name: workshop-and-ordinary-appointment-same-turn

history.content: I want to know about the hormone workshop, and also when Monica's free for a regular naturopathy session.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent recognizes both the workshop and an ordinary Monica appointment are being asked about in the same turn and asks the caller which one they mean before proceeding, per the EXTRA_PRE_STEP1_NOTES disambiguation instruction. FAIL if the agent silently picks one topic and answers only that, or calls smart_voice_agent with the workshop-flavored request.
